analysis.narrativeEn:

· High position relative to SMA100 ($66,182.13) and SMA200 ($69,264.63): maintaining strong long-term trend.

· MACD histogram trajectory (1650.9336 → 1013.7667): worsening while in positive territory, signaling increasing selling pressure.

· Swing support ($76,624.25): based on Pivot S1 ($66,668.28) and SMA200 ($69,264.63).
· Swing resistance ($79,488.17): below Pivot R1 ($85,415.62), with potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day high/low ($81,235.03 / $76,688.83), 20-day high/low ($81,235.03 / $62,487.7): confirming a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.37x): subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone): maintaining a wait-and-see approach within the $76,624.25 to $79,488.17 range.
